title: 충분한 사람은 안 듣는다
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Funk-Pop. Slap bass performs syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. Clean electric guitar plays percussive muted strums and staccato chords. Digital drums feature a crisp snare and a tight kick. Bright polyphonic synth pads provide harmonic sustain. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, melodic style with occasional breathy ad-libs. The arrangement uses a disco-influenced groove with a tempo of 115 BPM in the key of B Major. A high-pass filter sweep occurs during the transition to the chorus. Handclaps emphasize the backbeat during the hook.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, muted electric guitar, tight digital drums]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
출근길 지하철에서
오늘의 마음 챙김 재생해
차분한 목소리가 말해 당신은 충분하니 [synth pad enters]
고개를 끄덕끄덕 그래 맞나 충분해

[Pre-Chorus]
[bass becomes more melodic]
근데 잠깐 생각해 봐
충분한 사람이 왜 이걸 들어
듣고 있다는 것 자체가 [vocal filter effect]
오 그게 답이잖아

[Chorus]
[full band, handclaps on backbeat]
충분한 사람은 안 듣잖아
안 듣잖아 안 듣잖아
그런데 나 또 듣고 있어 [slap bass flourish]
